Rivar the Hulk

Biography

Rivar the Hulk becomes captain after Gort. Though exceptionally strong, he admits that he dislikes fighting and is no gifted speaker. He shares his family’s secret of strength with Zak and supports him against Erfar. His later admission that the prisoner escaped shows the limits of his vigilance. [1, 2, 3]
